game.name: Lego Dimensions (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,Nl,Da)
game.desc: LEGO Dimensions is a multi-franchise toys-to-life game featuring characters and levels from 14 licensed franchises with additional franchises due to arrive in the future. The game contains elements from the Middle Earth franchise, The LEGO Movie, DC Comics, The Wizard of Oz, The Simpsons, Back to the Future, Scooby-Doo, Doctor Who, Portal 2, the Midway Arcade franchise, LEGO Legends of Chima, LEGO Ninjago, Ghostbusters, and Jurassic World.
